That completes my whole wishlist. Bringing in my existing browser bookmarks — folders becoming collections and tags, duplicates skipped, and a clear count of what came in — is just what I needed, and being able to export everything back out means I'm never locked in. 

Stepping back: saving a link with the details filled in for me, organizing with tags, searching, favorites and read-later, no duplicate pile-ups, and now import/export — that's everything I set out to be able to do with my bookmarks, and it all holds together. I'm happy with it as it stands.
